name: Kon Lionis
abstract_title: Recursive Equilibrium: A Unified Framework for Epistemic, Ethical, Semantic, and Topological Stability in Intelligent Systems
abstract: This paper introduces Recursive Equilibrium, a unified mathematical architecture that models cognition and consciousness as the co-stabilization of four coupled layers: epistemic balance, ethical reflexivity, semantic coherence, and topological invariance.
